experience_gap.title: Experience Gap
exceptions: If candidate has equivalent seniority from adjacent field (IB → PE)
If JD says 'or equivalent experience'
If candidate has accelerated trajectory (early promotions)
experience_gap.fallback_advice: This is typically a hard filter. Consider: (1) targeting roles 1 level below, (2) networking for warm introduction to bypass ATS, (3) gaining missing years before applying.
fix_strategies: Target VP-level roles instead of Director
Network for warm introduction to bypass initial screen
Emphasize accelerated career progression in cover letter
Highlight equivalent experience from adjacent roles

missing_required_credential.rule: JD requires credential AND candidate lacks it AND JD uses 'required/must have'
missing_required_credential.title: Missing Required Credential
exceptions: If JD says 'preferred' instead of 'required'
If candidate is 'in progress' (CFA L2/L3, studying for exam)
If role description elsewhere suggests flexibility
missing_required_credential.fallback_advice: Many firms use credentials as ATS filters. If you're in progress, state clearly: 'CFA Level II Candidate (June 2025 exam)'. If not started, this role may require you to begin the qualification.
fix_strategies: Start credential immediately and mention in application
Explicitly state progress: 'CFA Level II Candidate (Exam June 2025)'
Address directly in cover letter first paragraph

geographic_mismatch.rule: JD location does not match CV location AND JD says 'must be based'
geographic_mismatch.title: Location Mismatch
exceptions: Candidate explicitly states willingness to relocate
JD mentions visa sponsorship available
Role is remote/hybrid with occasional travel
geographic_mismatch.fallback_advice: Address in cover letter paragraph 1: 'I am actively relocating to [City] and available to start [date].' Without this, ATS/recruiter assumes you're not serious.
fix_strategies: State relocation plans explicitly in cover letter opening
Mention specific move date if known
Reference any connections to target city (family, prior residence)

sector_mismatch.rule: JD requires specific sector AND candidate has no experience in that sector
sector_mismatch.title: Sector Experience Gap
exceptions: Transferable sectors (see industries.json transferable_from)
Generalist roles that value diverse exposure
Role explicitly says 'sector experience not required'
sector_mismatch.fallback_advice: Sector specialists are preferred for most senior roles. Highlight any tangential exposure or transferable knowledge. Consider targeting generalist roles or firms known for sector transitions.
fix_strategies: Highlight any projects in the target sector
Reference transferable subsector experience
Demonstrate sector knowledge through networking/research

seniority_mismatch.rule: JD seniority level is 2+ levels above candidate's current level
seniority_mismatch.title: Seniority Gap
exceptions: Exceptional performance with documented early promotions
Startup/smaller firm experience that involved senior responsibilities
seniority_mismatch.fallback_advice: Targeting roles 2+ levels above your current position is rarely successful. Focus on the next level up and plan your career progression.
fix_strategies: Target roles one level up instead
Emphasize any acting/interim senior responsibilities
Network for stretch opportunities rather than cold applying

visa_sponsorship.rule: JD says 'no visa sponsorship' AND candidate requires sponsorship
visa_sponsorship.title: Visa Requirement
exceptions: Candidate already has work authorization
Candidate will have authorization by start date
visa_sponsorship.fallback_advice: If a JD explicitly states no sponsorship, the company has likely made a policy decision. Focus on roles at sponsors-friendly firms or consider obtaining work authorization independently.
fix_strategies: Target firms known for visa sponsorship
Explore visa options independently (investor visa, etc.)
Consider roles in your home country or where you have authorization

language_requirement.rule: JD requires language AND candidate does not speak it fluently
language_requirement.title: Language Requirement
exceptions: Candidate is actively learning (intermediate level+)
JD says 'preferred' rather than 'required'
language_requirement.fallback_advice: Language requirements are usually non-negotiable for client-facing or specific geographic roles. Begin learning if this is a target sector/region.
fix_strategies: Begin intensive language study
Target roles in your fluent language regions
Mention any existing proficiency level honestly

deal_size_mismatch.rule: JD requires large-cap deal experience AND candidate only has small/mid-cap
deal_size_mismatch.title: Deal Size Gap
exceptions: Candidate led deals at smaller firm (equivalent responsibility)
Role is at smaller fund where mid-cap experience is relevant
deal_size_mismatch.fallback_advice: Large-cap and small-cap deal dynamics differ significantly. Your experience may translate, but you'll need to address this gap explicitly.
fix_strategies: Emphasize complexity of deals regardless of size
Highlight any exposure to larger transactions
Target mid-market focused firms

fund_size_mismatch.rule: JD is at megafund AND candidate only has experience at small funds
fund_size_mismatch.title: Fund Size Gap
exceptions: Role is explicitly for someone to bring different perspective
Candidate has bulge bracket IB experience
fund_size_mismatch.fallback_advice: Megafunds typically hire from other megafunds, elite boutiques, or top consulting. Your path may require an intermediate step.
fix_strategies: Consider mid-sized fund as intermediate step
Leverage IB/consulting background if applicable
Network aggressively for warm introductions
